exclusions.reason: Temporary repository-specific exception: braces3.0.3 has no published fixed version. Knip consumes repository-controlled glob patterns and can be crashed by deeply nested braces, including through PR changes to its entry config. This accepts validation-process availability risk for reviewed checkouts rather than claiming the dependency is safe or dev-only. It does not authorize processing untrusted glob input in a service, adding the exception to shared templates, or suppressing any other advisory. Recheck registry/upstream by 2026-10-16 and remove once a compatible fix is available. See evidence/4326/security-audit-review.md.

Temporary repository-specific exception: zod 3.25.76 enters only through eslint-plugin-react-compiler 19.1.0-rc.2 (its latest release, which requires zod ^3.22.4), and the advisory's only patched release is 4.6.6, so no compatible fix exists. The plugin validates its own lint options with zod while linting reviewed checkouts; no untrusted request input reaches it. This accepts lint-process memory-exhaustion risk for reviewed checkouts rather than claiming the dependency is safe. It does not authorize suppressing GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 for zod 4 (the expo governance floor is raised to ^4.6.6 in the same change), adding the exception to shared templates, or suppressing any other advisory. Recheck by 2026-11-24 and remove once the plugin accepts zod 4.6.6+.
